sellThenNews.description: r/wallstreetbets 2026 年 7 月 10 日情绪分析。讨论最多的股票代码：MU、SPCX、META、AAPL、SNDK。人工智能生成的零售流程、牛市/熊市叙述和关键主题的摘要。

sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • AAPL sues OpenAI for stealing trade secrets (broke during Friday’s session): Apple accused OpenAI in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California of systematically stealing trade secrets “from technical employees all the way up to the chief hardware officer” for use in developing its consumer hardware products (after acquiring Jony Ive’s IO Products and entering the hardware business). The lawsuit named two former Apple engineers of Chinese descent; one allegedly left without returning a laptop and downloaded confidential documents. AAPL closed Friday at 315.32 (-0.27%). OpenAI is not publicly listed, so there is no direct tradable ticker; this was the most-discussed news in the community over the weekend.
  • META posts its best weekly performance since early 2024: +5.98% on Friday to close at 669.25, up roughly +15% for the week, erasing its year-to-date losses. Catalysts included the Muse Spark 1.1 agent model + Muse Image image model, along with its in-house Iris chip (scheduled for production in September, targeting 14GW of compute power) and its self-built Meta Compute cloud business challenging AWS/Azure. META rallied nearly 100 points in two days, crushing shorts.
  • NVDA single-handedly saves the market: +4.09% Friday to close at 210.99, breaking above 210. Together with META, it carried the broader market. SPY closed Friday at 755.1 (+0.47%), approaching ATH, while QQQ closed at 726.27 (+0.42%). But IWM alone fell -0.40% (296.03), and DIA rose +0.31%. The main tone of the entire session was a low-volume grind higher with extremely narrow breadth.
  • SK Hynix chairman warns of a memory super-shortage: CEO Kwak Noh-jung said in his first English-language interview that 2027 will see “the worst memory shortage in history,” with supply-demand imbalance lasting beyond 2030. Customers are signing long-term contracts to lock in volume, but “it still isn’t enough.” Yet SKHY ADR traded flat after its first day, MU closed Friday at 980.68 (-1.05%), pinned below 1000, while SNDK stood out with +3.38% to close at 1919.84.
  • Geopolitics escalate again: Trump declared the ceasefire “over,” the U.S. military conducted precision strikes on 80 Iranian targets, and CENTCOM deployed 20 additional warships and 2 carrier strike groups toward Iran (officially announced only 24 minutes after the close). Trump gave Iran a Saturday deadline to “publicly apologize and open the Strait of Hormuz,” otherwise face “harsh consequences.” Shipping through the Strait plunged.
  • Other: ORCL fell -2.46% Friday (140.68), oddly going flat after Thursday’s surge; NFLX fell -2.76% (73.38), nearing lows ahead of 7/16 earnings; SPCX broke below its IPO price intraday, down -4.11% (145.81); BE -4.81%, HOOD -2.78%, MRVL -2.63%, and INTC -2.53% were broadly weak.

社区氛围：总体来说，表面欢腾，内心分裂——多头庆祝 META/NVDA 的猛烈反弹，空头用特朗普的“24 小时道歉”表情嘲讽，而许多非 AI 持有者则感叹“在上涨的市场中，我所有的股票都在流血”，形成了“SPY 牛市，90% 股票熊市”的脱钩世界观。周末地缘政治的不确定性又增加了一层，使情绪在贪婪和焦虑之间摇摆不定。

恐惧/贪婪：贪婪倾向（约 68/100）。典型的信号包括密集的声明“不再购买看跌期权”、“押注 ATH 开仓”和“全港看涨期权”，以及一波投降浪潮（“我一卖出，MU 就上涨”，“整天做空 NVDA，它没有动”）。但有关“指数波动性已被压缩到极致并准备爆发”的警告，以及 IWM 的疲软，表明平静表面之下的紧张局势。

情绪与现实：社区情绪比市场的实际走势更为极端。 SPY仅上涨0.47%，涨幅非常窄，但评论中却充满了“熔涨”和“疯狂反弹”的错觉。大多数人的实际损益取决于他们是否抓住了像 META/NVDA/SNDK 这样的少数名字；那些没有的人通常是红色的。这种“指数与个人损益差异”是本次分析中最突出的现象。
